[[Fenrir's Bastion]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] dropped by [[Fenrir]], a [[boss]] who can be found in [[Norrhart Domains]].

==Stats==
:[[Armor rating|Armor]] 16 (Requires 9 [[Motivation]])
:Received [[physical damage]] -2 (while [[Enchantment|Enchanted]])
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Equine Aegis]].
